production.note: US model years. First: 'The 2024 Nissan Z NISMO is on sale now with a starting Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of $65,750.' Still on sale: 'The 2027 Nissan Z NISMO adds an available six-speed manual transmission' (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit).

body.note: Inferred from Nissan's description of the two-seat Z sports car; sold only as a coupe.

fuel.note: Inferred from Nissan's description of a conventional twin-turbo V6; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: 2024 to 2026: 'NISMO-tuned 9-speed automatic' only; the 2024 table marks the 6-speed manual '-' for NISMO (nissan-us-2024-z-nismo-press-kit). From 2027: 'The 2027 Nissan Z NISMO adds an available six-speed manual transmission'; 2027 table: '6-speed close-ratio manual w/EXEDY high-performance clutch' S, 'NISMO-tuned 9-speed automatic' O.

powerHp.note: 2024 model year. Quotes: "420 @ 6,400 rpm" (specifications table) and "420 horsepower and 384 lb-ft of torque, increases of 20 hp and 34 lb-ft compared to other Z grades". Unchanged for 2027: NISMO "420 @ 6,400 rpm" (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit).

weightLb.note: 2024 model year, NISMO-tuned 9-speed automatic (the only transmission offered that year). Quote ('Weights' table, Total row, columns Sport MT | Sport AT | Performance MT | Performance AT | NISMO AT): "3,486 | 3,549 | 3,536 | 3,602 | 3,704". The 2027 kit gives NISMO MT 3,624 lb and NISMO AT 3,677 lb (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit); see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Both are Nissan USA totals for the NISMO with the 9-speed automatic: 3,704 lb in the 2024 kit, 3,677 lb in the 2027 kit. The 2027 manual NISMO is 3,624 lb.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,704 lb because the reference model year is 2024, when the automatic was the only transmission.
